title: 3 reform panels to chart Karnataka Police’s path to AI-led modernisation
summary: From incorporating artificial intelligence and upgrading 112 emergency response systems to restructuring recruitment and workload, Karnataka has set up three high-level panels to execute a major police overhaul.

title: T-AIM launches Mobility AI Grand Challenge
summary: The Telangana AI Mission (T-AIM) launched the Mobility AI Grand Challenge to foster innovation for GHMC. In this challenge, GHMC aims to identify and classify pothole severity across specified routes in Hyderabad using live and archived video feeds.

title: Telangana government launches AI-based skill enhancement platform for IIIT-Basara students
summary: State government in collaboration with MyPerfectice launched an AI-based skill enhancement platform for IIIT Basara students

title: Tamil Nadu: AI-enabled e-Sevai 2.0 to bring 1,000 services under one platform
summary: Tamil Nadu’s proposed e-Sevai 2.0 platform is being designed to use artificial intelligence (AI) and integrate up to 1,000 government services, compared with the 275 available on the existing platform. The proposed system is also intended to help eligible citizens access certain services without having to submit fresh applications.
